title: The Rights of Children upon Parents in Tarbiyah and Justice

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children upon their parents, mentioning examples from the Prophetic Sunnah regarding the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their education. It clarifies the importance of justice among children in giving and treatment. It points to the necessity of caring for children and providing for their psychological and material needs.
